title: Gouravam
desc: Arjun reaches his friend Shanmughan's village, only to find out that he has eloped with Pasupathy's daughter. So, Arjun, along with his friends and Yazhini, a lawyer, sets out to find the couple.

title: NGk
desc: Nandha Gopalan Kumaran, a social worker, is forced to join politics to help his village. He faces various obstacles while learning the tricks to survive in power.

title: Ethir Neechal
desc: When a man's deception about his real name is revealed, he is compelled to join a marathon to prove himself to his lover.

title: Ramleela-Govindudu Andariva
desc: Upset that his son wants to settle in London, Balaraju has a bitter argument with him. Later, his grandson travels to India to mend the relationship between his father and grandfather.

title: Petromax
desc: Saravanan, an Indian living abroad, struggles to sell his ancestral home in India due to the supposed presence of ghosts in it. He devises a plan to prove that his house is not haunted.

title: Chithha
desc: Living a quiet life with his niece, Eeswaran manages to provide for her and nurtures her like a parent. However, his journey takes an insidious turn when she goes missing.

title: Hello
desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.

title: Balakrishna
desc: A money-minded local goon is hired to protect a woman from her family's rivals. However, he, initially, only accepts the job for the money but later falls in love with her.

title: Veppam
desc: Karthik's life changes when his father exploits his friend for a drug-peddling assignment.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Thalaippu Seithi
desc: A young journalist ventures out at night in search of better news stories when she discovers a politician's secret that lands her in a perilous situation.

title: Kaali
desc: Bharath, a surgeon working in the US, embarks on a mission to India, to find his biological parents and reconcile with them.

title: Maapillai Seenu
desc: Seenu's debt-driven escape to Dubai accidentally reroutes him to Hyderabad. Upon arrival, a shocking discovery leads him to orchestrate a cunning plan.

title: Oh Baby
desc: A seventy-year-old woman frustrated with her life, blames God for her misfortune. Subsequently, she magically transforms into a twenty-four-year-old after getting her photo taken at a studio.

title: Ithu Enga Area
desc: Hari and Karthika fall in love with each other but are distraught when they find they are from different castes. However, they decide to fight for their relationship and parents' approval.

title: Pulimurugan
desc: A small village seeks help from a man with extraordinary force to protect them against man-eating tigers and the drug mafia.

title: Pathaan
desc: A Pakistani general hires a private terror outfit to conduct attacks in India while Pathaan, an Indian secret agent, is on a mission to form a special unit.
